name: glass-tab-bar
props: Tabs, left to right. `icon` is a render function `({ color, size, focused }) => node`; `badge` (number | string) shows a red count bubble, hidden when 0 or ''.
Called when a different tab is pressed.
Labels under the icons. Icons-only tabs get a slightly larger icon.
Selected icon and label colour — black on light glass, white on dark unless the kit accent is customised.
Force light or dark glass, e.g. 'dark' over photos.
A separate circular glass button to the right (e.g. search), grouped with the bar so they melt together on iOS 26. `label` is its accessibility label.
Selection tick on tab change, light tap on the trailing button.
Style of the outer row. The bar does not position itself — place it (e.g. absolute, bottom: insets.bottom + 8).
Exported height of the bar (and the trailing circle) — pad your scroll content by it.
